name: Cinematic Rendering
definition: A physiologically-based volume rendering method that simulates the interaction of visible photons with volume data (CT or MRI) to produce photorealistic 3D images. It differs from traditional VR by tracing hundreds or thousands of photon paths per pixel rather than a single straight ray, accounting for scattering, absorption, and multiple bounces.
summary: Cinematic Rendering is a physically based volume rendering technique that generates photo-realistic medical images by tracing multiple photon paths to simulate global illumination effects like soft shadows and subsurface scattering.
